input: Prepare me for a meeting with Gong (gong.io)

challenges.evidence: Gong says most teams are layering agents onto fragmented data and uncoordinated workflows, so pilots can impress in demos but underdeliver in production; it describes the Revenue Harness as the answer to this execution and orchestration problem.
challenges.challenge: Turning AI pilots into reliable production outcomes.

challenges.evidence: Gong says third-party account and contact data is scattered across providers, leaving RevOps to stitch together information and sellers to research and validate records; its Mission Callisto launch is explicitly designed to close those gaps.
challenges.challenge: Incomplete and fragmented revenue data undermines trustworthy AI decisions.

challenges.evidence: Gong’s product-legal team says AI adoption is moving faster than governance, only 12% of organizations describe their AI governance as mature and proactive, and data and security concerns are the leading factors eroding trust in AI.
challenges.challenge: Security, privacy and regulatory concerns are eroding trust in AI adoption.

challenges.evidence: In an October interview, CEO Amit Bendov said customers had left in 2023 for competing bundles, warned that a horizontal product would lose to Microsoft, and set a goal of being clearly number one; he also said Gong must build its next growth engine before the current product reaches a ceiling.
challenges.challenge: Maintaining category leadership against bundled and general-purpose platform competition.

key_people.name: Amit Bendov
key_people.title: CEO and Co-Founder
key_people.recent: At Celebrate ’26 he announced Gong Activate and said the next step is AI that wins deals rather than only explaining how to win.

key_people.name: Eilon Reshef
key_people.title: Chief Product Officer and Co-Founder
key_people.recent: He authored the September Mission Callisto announcement, emphasizing richer context, agentic execution and measurable outcomes.

key_people.name: Liron Shtraichman
key_people.title: Chief R&D Officer
key_people.recent: Appointed on November 4, he is leading R&D and the expansion of Gong’s agentic capabilities across the Revenue Graph, Revenue Harness and operating surfaces.

key_people.name: Guy Havusha
key_people.title: Chief Information Security Officer
key_people.recent: Promoted on November 4, he now leads global security, privacy and compliance, making governance and data protection strategic differentiators for Gong’s agents.

key_people.name: Kavita Patel
key_people.title: Director, Product Legal
key_people.recent: Her August governance post laid out Gong’s operating approach to data access, privacy by design, lifecycle controls and accountable AI ownership.

priorities.evidence: Gong launched Gong Activate, Agent Builder and Deep Mode, positioning AI agents and reps to execute winning, retaining and expansion motions from shared blueprints; its CEO said the next phase is agents that take action and deliver results at enterprise scale.
priorities.priority: Move from revenue insight to governed, agentic execution at enterprise scale.

priorities.evidence: Mission Callisto adds third-party account and contact data, configurable provider waterfalls and automated enrichment to address fragmented data, missing contact details and manual research.
priorities.priority: Improve revenue context and data coverage through Gong Enrich and the Revenue Graph.

priorities.evidence: Gong Dashboards centralize metrics, targets and views across the revenue lifecycle, while Mission Callisto connects measurement back to agent and workflow execution; expanded Dashboard access and automatically triggered agents were rolling out during 2026.
priorities.priority: Create a measurable closed loop from performance analytics to action.

priorities.evidence: Gong appointed a CISO to lead global security, privacy and compliance as agents take on more of the revenue cycle, and its product-legal team described scoped access, lifecycle governance and ownership as prerequisites for responsible AI at scale.
priorities.priority: Build enterprise-grade security, privacy and AI governance into agent deployment.

what_they_do.value: Gong is the Revenue AI OS that turns insight into action—and action into sustainable growth for revenue teams.

recent_changes.summary: Shtraichman is charged with expanding agentic capabilities; Havusha is responsible for security, privacy and compliance as AI agents handle more of the revenue cycle.
recent_changes.headline: Gong appointed Liron Shtraichman Chief R&D Officer and Guy Havusha CISO.

recent_changes.summary: The release introduced Gong Enrich, Agent Builder, Deep Mode and expanded Dashboards, with Gong Activate coordinating agents and reps around shared revenue blueprints.
recent_changes.headline: Gong unveiled Mission Callisto and Gong Activate at Celebrate ’26.

talking_points: As Gong moves from insight to autonomous action, where are customers still seeing the biggest gap between a compelling AI pilot and reliable production execution?
With Mission Callisto combining Enrich, Agent Builder and Dashboards, which data-quality or workflow bottleneck is most limiting the next step in Gong’s revenue loop?
As security, privacy and governance become part of Gong’s differentiation, how are customers balancing agent autonomy, human approval and measurable ROI?
